assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
with a related history of atrial flutter (I47.1)
Given the episodic nature of these symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
a 48-hour Holter monitor (CPT 93226) is ordered to capture potential arrhythmic episodes
This study will assist in confirming the diagnosis and guiding appropriate rate or rhythm control management
which is medically necessary for this member with diagnosis code I49.9
